record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The four Castform forms in appliesTo declare FORECAST in this production reference. All share one strategy; the form is read from pokemon.name, so CASTFORM_SUN, CASTFORM_RAIN and CASTFORM_HAIL each add one extra team-wide buff and plain CASTFORM adds only the shield.
record.summary: Self-and-team support with no damage: every unit on the caster's team (the caster included) gains a shield (raw 10, or 20 at 4 stars); in addition CASTFORM_SUN gives the same team +4 ATK, CASTFORM_RAIN +8 PP and CASTFORM_HAIL +2 DEF and +2 SPE_DEF (doubled at 4 stars). Plain CASTFORM gives only the shield.

targeting.who: all units of the caster's team found on the board at cast time (the target parameter is null-typed and unused)
targeting.note: requiresTarget = false overrides the base default, so no enemy target is needed to cast.

geometry.shape: whole board, filtered to allies (includes the caster)

effects.scaling: apBoost 1: shield x (1 + AP/100), then x critPower if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false), then halved if the receiving ally is enraged, then rounded
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after Big Eater Belt on the receiver (x1.25 rounded down, done first in PokemonEntity.addShield), the caster's AP and crit, the enraged halving and rounding; no effect on a receiver with hp <= 0. The caster's AP and crit are used, not the receiver's.

effects.target: each ally including the caster, only when the caster's name is CASTFORM_SUN
effects.scaling: apBoost 1: round(4 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit)
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after rounding, Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down for a holder) and Twist Band (no effect on a positive value); ATK is floored at 1; not permanent (permanent defaults to false).

effects.target: each ally including the caster, only when the caster's name is CASTFORM_RAIN
effects.scaling: apBoost 1: round(8 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit x 0.5 if the receiver has fatigue)
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount; applied = after AP/crit/fatigue rounding; refused entirely for a receiver that is silenced, protected, has NO_PP_GAIN or is resurrecting; the new PP is clamped to 2 x maxPP - 1. Big Eater Belt is not applied to PP in addPP.

effects.target: each ally including the caster, only when the caster's name is CASTFORM_HAIL
effects.scaling: apBoost 1 for each of the two stats: round(2 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit)
effects.resolution: requested = the raw amount, applied separately to DEF and SPE_DEF after rounding, Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down) and Twist Band (no effect on positive values); floored at 0; not permanent.

starBehavior.note: every table is indexed by the casting entity's stars with the same shape [x, x, x, 2x]; the 4-star value is also the fallback and is not reachable by the four units' bare star counts. maxPP and range are in appliesTo.

record.positionalConditions: None: board position is irrelevant; the caster's own team membership is the only filter. Form-specific buffs depend on pokemon.name equalling a specific Pkm value.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast adds the shield and the form-specific buff again; stat buffs are not permanent and PP is clamped.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: shield 10 (20 at 4 stars); sun ATK 4 (8); rain PP 8 (16); hail DEF and SPE_DEF 2 (4). Resolved amounts depend on caster AP and crit, and on the receiver's items and status as listed per effect.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence); only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Whether the units named CASTFORM_* keep those names during a fight (the CASTFORM passive changes form; its code was not read here), which decides the form-specific buff
Other effects hooked on gaining a shield or a stat (item or synergy reactions)
unresolved: The Castform passive (form change) and how pokemon.name is set during a fight were not read
Whether any item or synergy effect changes FORECAST beyond Big Eater Belt, Twist Band, enraged, fatigue and the PP blockers listed
Units not listed in appliesTo that might share the identifier are not covered
